findings.description: 28-unit apartment complex at 1275-1281 8th Ave. sold for $6.65 million in June 2026, three years after an August 2023 fire.

citation.label: Mission Local, “Inner Sunset apartment complex sold 3 years after fire. Tenants are ‘totally in the dark.’,” 14 October 2026

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 1281 08TH AVE → parcel 1742014; sf-parcels has blklot 1742014 active, 1275–1281 08TH; the 2025 roll records it as multi-family residential, built 1926. EAS puts 1275, 1277, 1279, 1281 08TH AVE on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 1275. The record writes the street 8TH; EAS holds the numbered streets zero-padded to four characters, so this is 08TH.

publish.note: Entry added to the existing page at 1275 8th Avenue; no seeding needed.
